summary: Project a point-pitch source onto integer-regular even angular modes with converged normalization quadrature.

identity.relation: Mirror-ratio loss-cone state and NBI source configuration to fractional Legendre degrees and source coefficients
identity.direction: (params, optional spectrum_operator) -> degrees, source_coefficients, degree_source, legendre controls, xi_tp_mid and fractional_mode callable
identity.definition: Set xi_tp_mid=sqrt(max(0,1-1/max(R,1e-12))) from mirror_ratio or turning_b. Use caller-supplied degrees or a supplied spectrum operator. For computed coefficients, c_nu=u_nu(clip(cos(theta_NBI),0,xi_tp_mid))/(4*pi*integral_0^xi_tp_mid u_nu^2 dxi). u_nu solves the regular even initial-value equation without integer exclusion or polynomial truncation. Successively doubled Gauss-Legendre rules normalize each mode; the initial node count resolves its estimated angular oscillation scale and the integral must agree within relative 1e-10.
identity.model: Angular point-source projection with caller-specified or numerically generated modes; it does not establish a physical NBI population.
identity.geometry: One-dimensional pitch-cosine interval from xi=0 to the mirror-ratio-derived turning boundary xi_tp_mid
identity.coordinates: xi and degree are dimensionless. nbi_pitch_angle_deg is in degrees and converted through cosine; the angle cosine is clipped to the active interval. Returned degree and coefficient arrays preserve supplied order.
identity.boundary: Regular modes satisfy u(0)=1 and u′(0)=0. Caller-supplied degrees are not automatically loss-cone eigenvalues. A nonpositive derived cone returns the existing inactive empty result.
assumptions: The caller supplies physically suitable fractional degrees or a compatible spectrum callable when no degrees are explicit; this function does not certify their loss-cone boundary roots.
The coefficient formula treats the NBI pitch as a point-source direction with the source-defined 4*pi angular normalization; external source amplitude and transport physics are not modeled.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Configuration dict holding mirror_ratio or turning_b; optional legendre_degrees, source_coefficients, legendre_terms, legendre_backend, legendre_mode_count, legendre_spectrum_grid_points and nbi_pitch_angle_deg.
inputs.units: mirror ratio, degrees and xi: dimensionless; coefficients: caller source normalization when explicit; NBI pitch: degree; terms, mode_count and grid_points: count
inputs.shape: dict with scalar controls and optional one-dimensional degree/coefficient arrays
inputs.constraints: Must be a dict. R defaults to 2.0; legendre_terms to 15 and backend to 'truncated'. In the active branch, terms converted with int must be >=2 and backend must be 'truncated' or 'hypergeometric'; explicit degrees must form a nonempty finite 1-D array. Explicit coefficients must be finite with the same shape. Other controls are converted only on their exercised branch, and unknown keys are ignored. legendre_terms and the two backend names remain legacy controls; active mode evaluation is the same untruncated scaled initial-value solution. Integer degrees are allowed.

inputs.name: spectrum_operator
inputs.description: Caller-provided degree generator when legendre_degrees is absent in the active branch.
inputs.units: xi_tp_mid and returned degrees: dimensionless; mode_count and grid_points: count; backend: text
inputs.shape: None or callable(xi_tp_mid, mode_count, grid_points, backend) -> mapping containing degrees
inputs.constraints: Required only in the active branch without explicit degrees. It receives int-converted counts defaulting to 6 and 256 and the selected backend; returned degrees must form a nonempty finite 1-D array. The callable is supplied by the caller, not imported or validated for scientific equivalence here.

outputs.name: degrees
outputs.description: Explicit degrees or the supplied spectrum callable's degree array, in original order.
outputs.constraints: Finite nonempty active array; integer degrees are allowed. Caller-supplied degrees are not certified as endpoint roots.

outputs.name: source_coefficients
outputs.description: Explicit coefficients or NBI pitch projection coefficients paired with degrees.
outputs.units: computed branch: dimensionless in the source-defined normalized angular convention; explicit branch: caller-supplied normalization
outputs.constraints: Explicit values must be finite and shape-matched. Computed values require finite positive norm and relative quadrature agreement; no denominator floor is used.

outputs.name: degree_source
outputs.constraints: One of 'caller_supplied', 'scirel.kinetic.loss_cone_spectrum' or 'inactive_loss_cone'. The spectrum label is fixed even if the injected callable is not SciRel's solver.

outputs.name: legendre_terms
outputs.description: Legacy term-count control retained in the interface.
outputs.constraints: Active branch requires int-converted value at least two; it does not truncate mode evaluation.

outputs.name: legendre_backend
outputs.shape: scalar when active; absent when inactive
outputs.constraints: Both 'truncated' and 'hypergeometric' select the same regular scaled initial-value evaluator; the inactive branch has no key.

outputs.name: xi_tp_mid
outputs.constraints: Computed from max-clamped R; zero enters the inactive branch. No independent finite or physical R>1 validation is performed.

outputs.name: fractional_mode
outputs.description: Callable evaluating the normalized fractional Legendre mode at a requested degree, pitch cosine and term count.
outputs.shape: callable(degree, xi, terms) -> scalar or array
outputs.constraints: Returned callable uses the regular even solution for finite nonnegative degrees and finite |xi|<1. Integer degrees are supported. It may raise on invalid input or failed integration.

preconditions: Finite valid active configuration and a suitable angular source convention.
supported: Explicit degrees/coefficients or point-pitch projection with computed normalization; integer and noninteger degrees.
excluded: Certification of caller-supplied eigenvalues, finite-width source distributions or physical positivity of an arbitrary truncated mode sum.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid active degree/coefficient arrays, backend or term controls.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: RuntimeError when normalization rules fail relative 1e-10 agreement or require more than 8192 nodes.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Only the established inactive-cone branch returns empty arrays; failed active projections return no partial coefficients.

example.description: Project a regular integer mode and compare its analytic normalization.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.frank_egedal_source_projection import project_frank_egedal_source_modes
r=project_frank_egedal_source_modes({'mirror_ratio':1.5,'legendre_degrees':[2.],'nbi_pitch_angle_deg':60.})
a=1/np.sqrt(3); norm=a-2*a**3+9*a**5/5
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['source_coefficients'],[.25/(4*np.pi*norm)],rtol=2e-10)
example.expected: Integer degree 2 is evaluated regularly and its projected coefficient matches the polynomial integral.

scope: Exact integer-mode normalization and source coefficient.
Mode values share the independently checked regular evaluator.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Analytic identities, explicit failure regressions and independent numerical comparisons establish the stated mathematical contract. They do not establish measured-plasma validity or a general stability theorem.
known_limitations: Clipping the point-source pitch into the cone is the retained projection convention, not a finite-width injection model.
Caller-supplied degrees need an independent eigenvalue justification if used as loss-cone modes.
